title: edits.apply needs a formatter validation mode (rustfmt --check) for cosmetic correctness
wanted_capability: An optional validations entry like "rustfmt_check" on edits.apply that runs the language formatter in check mode after the write (alongside tree_sitter_no_errors). Probe-edits-1's first apply was syntactically valid but cosmetically wrong (doc comment separated from its item by a leftover blank line); tree-sitter cannot see whitespace adjacency, so the agent needed a human-eye re-read of the file to catch it. The probe-edits-2 retro explicitly proposed rustfmt integration as the right shape (a niche no_blank_before_doc_comment check was considered and rejected).
fallback_used: Re-read the file after apply and fixed spacing with a second EditSet round.
evidence: crates/bro-harness/src/bindings/edit_algebra.rs (EditsApply: validations enum is only tree_sitter_no_errors; unknown values are refused)
resolution_note: Transferred to https://github.com/daystrom-institute/blackbox/issues/38, now the canonical implementation work item. edits.apply still accepts only tree_sitter_no_errors validation; formatter-check validation and rollback remain work. Verified against accepted beta 93c2d391a8d6b8d2d760b88b1acdadbafc7a3ea4. Gap triage is complete; the GitHub issue remains open and this transfer does not claim the capability is implemented.
